recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒（particle）中紅色箭頭處可見一條線狀結構，由細長梭形核的內皮細胞沿淡藍色纖維狀基質排列而成，周圍混有各階段造血細胞與脂肪空泡，為正常的骨髓微血管，不要誤認為腫瘤細胞團。
features: Cellular marrow particle with fat spaces and trilineage hematopoietic cells
Linear structure (red arrow) formed by elongated spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei
Endothelial nuclei aligned in parallel along a pale blue fibrillar stromal strand
Surrounding maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes appear normal
No cohesive clusters of atypical non-hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing fat spaces and maturing trilineage hematopoietic cells. A linear structure (red arrow) composed of elongated, spindle-shaped nuclei aligned along a pale blue fibrillar strand traverses the particle, representing a capillary with its endothelial lining. The surrounding hematopoietic cells show normal maturation, and no cohesive atypical cell clusters are present. This is a normal marrow capillary, a stromal element that should not be mistaken for metastatic tumor.

ddx.vs: Tumor clusters consist of cohesive, round to polygonal cells with large atypical nuclei and nuclear molding, not flattened spindle nuclei aligned along a vessel wall.
Neoplastic mast cells are spindle-shaped but contain metachromatic purple granules and form aggregates, whereas endothelial cells are agranular.
Stromal fragments are disorganized sheets of spindle cells with collagen and are accompanied by atypical megakaryocytes, rather than a single tubular structure.
